entry_points.text: Removal ioctl needs second-gen, copies params, validates range, rejects nonzero progress, delegates and copies back; fault and mprotect validate ownership with busy to retry and ceiling enforcement; debug read and write use word-aligned slice.

Module init requires SGX, builds cache and unwinds on failure; memory failure signals sync consumer, poisons once and quarantines free pages; guest create and init validate buffers and map faults to traps; IPI callback is no-op.

Early limit starts from possible count, collapses to one when maxcpus zero or APIC disabled, clamps to command-line cap; possible-CPU init fakes boot APIC if missing, derives allowed from assigned plus disabled, publishes totals, derives package and thread maxima, seeds CPU zero and assigns disabled from unmarked SMT bits.

Transmeta early probe captures extended EDX caps when family matches and leaf exists; full init refreshes caps, sizes caches, logs revisions and 64-char id when leaves exist, briefly reveals hidden features around leaf-one refresh then restores, forces constant TSC and disables randomization where supported.

UMWAIT online reapplies cached control with IRQs briefly off, offline restores boot value under hotplug protection, resume reapplies after suspend; init exits without WAITPKG, else caches original once and installs handlers.
Scheduler clock scales raw TSC by multiplier and shift minus boot offset; setup derives those from cached TSC frequency.

exports.text: SGX exposes enclave, provisioning and virtual EPC misc devices with dynamic minors; enclave init gates on launch control plus first-gen support and derives masks, with file ops for open, lifetime, control, mapping and address selection.
Global EPC section table with populated count, free-page counter and NUMA presence mask track capacity distribution.
Enclave lifetime exports VMA ops table, notifier ops table, refcounted release teardown and reclaim-detach helper.
Topology exports APIC-window unit counting and primary-thread lookup; VMware exports slow hypercall dispatching on cached mode with optional secondary outputs.

hazards.text: Busy maps to retry at ioctl and fault layers, other failures to fault or bus errors; trapped faults are logged once or matched to expected page fault while logical failures return via result field; type-change and removal stay untracked across mutex-drop invalidation; cleared fork private fails cleanly.
Lockless poison check is racy but safe causing only redundant removal; persistent removal failure leaks and may disable facility; UMWAIT MSR write outside IRQ-off or mutex risks torn values.

invariants.text: Only control and trim are accepted targets; ordinary may go to either, control only to trim; ordinary-to-control needs prior RW and records RW ceiling restored on failure; removal needs trim plus in-enclave acceptance fault; both report byte progress even on failure.

Tracked load fails when missing or max omits access; eaug needs initialized, uses permissive rights, marks ordinary and bumps child count; fault uses eaug only with second-gen plus missing entry; EPC phys equals base plus index times page size.
Per-node EPC size exposes total bytes and stays invisible until first NUMA use; VEPC ioctl with zero walks all and counts blocked control pages, nonzero or unknown rejected.

Domain weight counts bits in level window extending by 2**shift; relative ID unshifted for SMT else shifted and masked; possible_cpus cap clamps early counts; UP holds without SMP config with Xen bypass.
Two constant tables map 0B/1F and 80000026 encodings to internal SMT, core, module/CCD, tile/socket, die and die-group domains.

UMWAIT stores parse bool C02 and u32 time, reject times with low two bits set and propagate only on change; VMware presence needs version call with non-all-ones accumulator plus magic match with TSC accessor returning cached kHz; steal enable passes split phys addr to stealclock command.

locks.text: Enclave mutex serializes lookup and mutation, dropped across table invalidation; reclaimer spinlock guards tracking with empty-while-tracked meaning busy; MM removal uses lock plus grace sync; teardown holds index lock with yield; reservation pinning maps busy to retry.
Global reclaimer and per-node locks guard free and poison queue moves; separate mutex guards version state; VEPC mutex serializes faults while zombie mutex guards deferred control list.
Dedicated mutex serializes UMWAIT stores; cached word uses once access, propagation runs on all CPUs, low-level MSR write needs interrupts disabled.

state_machines.text: Ordinary may become control or trim, control only trim; accepted trim is unmapped, detached, erased and freed with child decrement; eaug flows alloc, control load, EPC alloc, VA growth, insert and augment to reclaimable and mapped, with retry on contention and unwind on collision or hardware failure.
Fork duplicates attach via open with failure recorded as cleared private data; release removes attachment under lock with grace sync; final free drops enclave ref and frees record.

Sanitize drains dirty queue, diverts poisoned to node queue, returns cleaned and retains dirty with remaining count; background thread does two passes, warns on residue, then sleeps until stop or high-watermark pressure; cache setup maps sections and fails with none usable.
VEPC mapping needs shared semantics with no-dump no-fork flags; faults serialize with busy to retry else bus error; release frees child pages and reconciles unfreeable control pages via zombie list.
TSX control holds auto, enable, disable, always-abort and unsupported with build default; cmdline moves to enable on on, disable on off, auto on auto, disable with error otherwise, rejecting null.

structs.text: Enclave holds range, flags, counts, mutex, page index, control record, attrs, affinity, backing, refcount, VA list and MM list with lock; page holds descriptor, 8-bit ceiling, 16-bit type and EPC, owner and VA links; MM links enclave to address space, VA page holds EPC page with fixed-slot bitmap.

EPC page carries section index, flags, poison, owner and queue linkage; NUMA node holds free and poison queues, byte total and lock; section holds phys and virt bases, page array and node pointer; VEPC instance holds page index plus mutex.

Constants: VA 512 slots with offset bits 11-3; enclave bits ioctl 0 debug 1 created 2 initialized 3 and reclaim bit 3; EPC max 8 sections, scan 16, low 32 high 64; tracked bit0 free bit1; token 304 bytes.

Small record holds assigned, disabled, rejected counts plus boot IDs; scan pairs CPU info with shifts, counts, legacy shift and AMD node fields; Transmeta dev binds names, callbacks and vendor id; steal area overlays clock plus reserved words; UMWAIT encoding masks time and ORs C02-disable; VMware fixes info leaf with enabled code 1; firmware codes run invalid 0 to 1F maximum 7.
